exchanges.response_text:
[[columns]]
name = "customer_id"
type = "Int64"
nullable = false
description = "Primary key identifying each customer."

[[columns]]
name = "country"
type = "String"
nullable = true
description = "Country associated with the customer."

[[columns]]
name = "order_count"
type = "Int64"
nullable = true
description = "Total number of orders placed by the customer."

[[columns]]
name = "total_amount"
type = "Float64"
nullable = true
description = "Total monetary amount across all orders for the customer."

[[columns]]
name = "last_status"
type = "String"
nullable = true
description = "Status of the customer's most recent order."

[rules]
required = ["customer_id"]
protected = ["customer_id"]
